SidecarUrl.Name: Sidecar WebSocket URL
SidecarUrl.Hint: WebSocket URL of the Magi sidecar server (e.g., ws://127.0.0.1:3300)

SidecarToken.Name: Sidecar Auth Token
SidecarToken.Hint: Authentication token for connecting to the sidecar

EnableVideoCapture.Name: Enable Video Capture
EnableVideoCapture.Hint: Capture the canvas as video and stream to the sidecar for training data

VideoSidecarUrl.Name: Video WebSocket URL
VideoSidecarUrl.Hint: Dedicated WebSocket URL for video traffic (separate from game state to avoid blocking)

EnableDiagnostics.Name: Enable Diagnostics
EnableDiagnostics.Hint: Log periodic memory and WebSocket state probes to the browser console every 30s (for investigating leaks). Default off.

DirectorRunsTable.Name: Director runs the table
DirectorRunsTable.Hint: Let the Magi Director draw scenes, place and move tokens, mark the fallen, narrate and whisper, and create users for the people it seats, without asking each time. Speaking or rolling as an existing actor still asks unless the sidecar runs autonomously. Default off.

BridgeUser.Name: Bridge user
BridgeUser.Hint: Only this user's browser connects to the sidecar (e.g. a headless Gamemaster). Leave empty to let any GM connect. Set it when an assistant GM also plays, so their browser does not take over the connection.
